_comment: Cross-engine parity fixture for the master-gain sanitizer that bounds the gain baked into the rendered/exported mix on both engines. Read by web test test/unit/utils/audio/audio-master-gain.parity.test.ts (sanitizeMasterGain, src/utils/audio/clamp.ts) AND Rust test audio::mix::tests::sanitize_master_gain_matches_shared_parity_fixture (sanitize_master_gain, src-tauri/src/audio/mix.rs). A finite gain is clamped to [0, maxMasterGain]; any non-finite value (encoded here as the strings 'nan'/'inf'/'-inf') falls back to unity. The master-gain UI slider tops out at +12 dB (the 'ui-max-passes-through' case, 10^(12/20)), so the upper cap only ever engages for an out-of-range payload value — but it must engage identically across engines.
